code_prompt_defaults.object_description_standard_board: a numbered Snakes and Ladders board with one token and visible snakes and ladders
code_prompt_defaults.movement_rule_text: A move advances the token by the selected die value, then immediately follows a ladder upward or a snake downward if the landing square is the start of one. A ladder starts at its lower square and ends at the arrowhead on the higher square; a snake starts at its head and ends at its pointed tail on the lower square.
code_prompt_defaults.overshoot_rule_text: If a die roll would move past the final square, the token stays on its current square for that roll.
code_prompt_defaults.planning_rule_text: Each roll can independently be any die value from 1 to 6.
code_prompt_defaults.special_square_count_rule_text: Count by square number from just after the token's square through the final square. Do not move the token or follow snakes or ladders.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_move_outcome_value: set "annotation" to a JSON object mapping start_square and end_square to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1]
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_move_outcome_value: set "answer" to the final square number after the shown die roll and any snake or ladder
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_best_roll_value: set "annotation" to one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around the final square named in the answer
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_best_roll_value: set "answer" to the highest final square number reachable after independently choosing each stated roll, not to the die values
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_ladder_start_ahead_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] around every counted ladder-start square
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_ladder_start_ahead_count: set "answer" to the number of counted ladder-start squares
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_snake_head_ahead_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] around every counted snake-head square
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_snake_head_ahead_count: set "answer" to the number of counted snake-head squares
